categories.name: Robbery
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 293-299 (Robbery)
categories.kp_basis: RPC Art. 293-299 — prision correccional to reclusion perpetua, far beyond the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Theft
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 308-311 (Theft)
categories.kp_basis: Penalty scales with the value taken (RPC Art. 309 as amended by RA 10951). Mediable only for small values falling within the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]). Establish the value first.

categories.name: Slight Physical Injury
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 266 (Slight Physical Injuries)
categories.kp_basis: RPC Art. 266 — arresto menor (1–30 days), within the Sec. 408[c] ceiling. A crime, but still KP-mediable.

categories.name: Physical Injury
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 262 (Mutilation), 263 (Serious), 265 (Less Serious) Physical Injuries
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if LESS SERIOUS (RPC Art. 265, arresto mayor). EXCLUDED if SERIOUS (Art. 263) or mutilation (Art. 262) — those exceed the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]). Check the medical certificate and days of incapacity.

categories.name: Lost Property / Document
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 (barangay blotter recording); Civil Code Art. 719-720 (finder of lost movable property)
categories.kp_basis: Not a dispute between parties. Blotter recording only; Civil Code Art. 719-720 governs found property.

categories.name: Ejectment
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 1673 (grounds for judicial ejectment)
categories.kp_basis: Civil dispute; prior barangay conciliation is a condition precedent to filing (RA 7160 Sec. 412[a]).

categories.name: RA 9262 (VAWC)
categories.pnp_basis: RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act)
categories.kp_basis: EXPRESS STATUTORY BAR — RA 9262 Sec. 33 prohibits barangay conciliation of VAWC cases. Do not mediate; assist with a Barangay Protection Order (Sec. 14) and refer.

categories.name: Online Defamation / Threat
categories.pnp_basis: RA 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act) in relation to RPC Art. 355 (Libel) / Art. 282 (Grave Threats)
categories.kp_basis: RA 10175 Sec. 6 raises the penalty one degree above RPC Art. 355, exceeding the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Oral Defamation
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); may escalate to RPC Art. 358 (Oral Defamation) if unresolved
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if SLIGHT slander (RPC Art. 358, arresto menor). SERIOUS slander reaches prision correccional minimum and exceeds the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Marital Relation
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Family Code Art. 149 et seq. (The Family)
categories.kp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 408 — but re-screen for RA 9262 (VAWC). If any element of violence appears, KP is barred.

categories.name: Malicious Mischief / Property Damage
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 327-331 (Malicious Mischief)
categories.kp_basis: Penalty scales with the damage value (RPC Art. 328-329). Establish the value, then apply the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Property Claim / Damage
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 2176 (quasi-delict)
categories.kp_basis: Civil claim under Civil Code Art. 2176 — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Grave Threats / Light Threats
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 282 (Grave Threats); Art. 285 (Light Threats)
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if LIGHT threats (RPC Art. 285, arresto menor). GRAVE threats (Art. 282) depend on whether a condition was attached and achieved — apply the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Unjust Vexation
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 287 (Unjust Vexation)
categories.kp_basis: RPC Art. 287 — arresto menor / fine, within the Sec. 408[c] ceiling.

categories.name: Alarms and Scandals
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 155 (Alarms and Scandals)
categories.kp_basis: RPC Art. 155 is within the penalty ceiling, but check RA 7160 Sec. 408[d] — with no private offended party, KP does not apply.

categories.name: Trespassing
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 280 (Qualified Trespass to Dwelling); Art. 281 (Other Forms of Trespass)
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if OTHER FORMS of trespass (RPC Art. 281, arresto menor). EXCLUDED if QUALIFIED trespass to dwelling (Art. 280, prision correccional).

categories.name: Noise Complaint
categories.pnp_basis: Local noise ordinance, enacted under RA 7160 Sec. 16 (General Welfare Clause)
categories.kp_basis: Ordinance violation with a private complainant; fine within the Sec. 408[c] ceiling.

categories.name: Neighbor Dispute
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay)
categories.kp_basis: Core Lupon subject matter — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Estafa (Swindling)
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 315 (Estafa)
categories.kp_basis: Penalty scales with the amount defrauded (RPC Art. 315 as amended by RA 10951). Establish the amount, then apply the penalty ceiling: imprisonment > 1 yr or fine > P5,000 (RA 7160 Sec. 408[c]).

categories.name: Boundary Dispute
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 434 (accion reivindicatoria)
categories.kp_basis: Civil dispute; real property within the same city/municipality (RA 7160 Sec. 408[e]).

categories.name: Animal-Related Incident
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 2183 (possessor of animal's liability)
categories.kp_basis: Civil liability of the animal's possessor, Civil Code Art. 2183 — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Coercion
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 286 (Grave Coercion); Art. 287 (Light Coercion)
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if LIGHT coercion (RPC Art. 287). EXCLUDED if GRAVE coercion (Art. 286, prision correccional).

categories.name: Using Fictitious Names / False Certificates
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 178 (Using Fictitious Name); Art. 171-172 (Falsification)
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if use of a fictitious name (RPC Art. 178, arresto mayor). EXCLUDED if falsification (Art. 171-172, prision correccional or higher).

categories.name: Breach of Contract
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 1170 et seq. (Breach of Obligations)
categories.kp_basis: Civil dispute — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Demand for Specific Performance
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 1191 / 1233 et seq. (Specific Performance)
categories.kp_basis: Civil dispute — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Family/Sibling Dispute
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Family Code provisions on family relations
categories.kp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 408; Family Code Art. 151 requires earnest efforts toward a compromise.

categories.name: Child Custody-Adjacent Concern
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay, referral); Family Code Art. 213 (custody of children)
categories.kp_basis: Custody falls within the exclusive original jurisdiction of the Family Courts (RA 8369 Sec. 5). Record and refer; coordinate with the DSWD / VAWC desk.

categories.name: Vehicular Incident
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 365 (Reckless Imprudence); RA 4136 (Land Transportation and Traffic Code)
categories.kp_basis: Reckless imprudence (RPC Art. 365) — the penalty follows the resulting harm. Damage to property alone is normally mediable; EXCLUDED where death or serious physical injury resulted.

categories.name: Public Disturbance
categories.pnp_basis: RPC Art. 153 (Tumults and Other Disturbances of Public Order)
categories.kp_basis: RPC Art. 153. Check RA 7160 Sec. 408[d] — a purely public-order matter with no private offended party is outside KP.

categories.name: Drug-Related Concern
categories.pnp_basis: RA 9165 (Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002)
categories.kp_basis: RA 9165 — penalties far beyond the ceiling, and no private offended party (RA 7160 Sec. 408[d]). Refer to the PNP / PDEA.

categories.name: Missing Person Report
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 (barangay blotter recording/referral) — not itself an offense
categories.kp_basis: Not a dispute between parties; there is nothing to conciliate. Blotter recording and referral only.

categories.name: Referral to Police/Other Agency
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 408-409 (Katarungang Pambarangay jurisdictional exceptions requiring referral)
categories.kp_basis: Already a Sec. 408-409 jurisdictional exception — this label exists to record the referral.

categories.name: Collection of Sum of Money
categories.pnp_basis: RA 7160 Sec. 399-422 (Katarungang Pambarangay); Civil Code Art. 1156 et seq. (Obligations)
categories.kp_basis: Civil dispute between residents — RA 7160 Sec. 408.

categories.name: Peeping/Voyeurism
categories.pnp_basis: RA 9995 (Anti-Photo and Video Voyeurism Act) if photo/video capture occurred; else RPC Art. 287 (Unjust Vexation)
categories.kp_basis: Mediable if it amounts only to unjust vexation (RPC Art. 287). EXCLUDED if photo or video capture occurred — RA 9995 carries 3 to 7 years.
